clips.start_words: You look familiar. You're Bobby Singer,
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says he once sat down and told the universe exactly what he wanted: $100,000 a week, for life, from his memory training business.

One week later, at the Carnegie Deli in New York, he recognized the stranger sitting next to him - a TV infomercial guy. They got talking about his memory course. The guy said, "Put this on TV."

The same day, back at his hotel, a different old friend left a message saying the exact same thing - a second infomercial expert offering the exact same deal.

He signed with the first one. Mega Memory went on to do $450 million in sales.

What are you asking the universe for, specifically?

#kevintrudeau #manifesting #megamemory #yourwishisyourcommand #success #wealthmindset

Why don't wealthy people teach the real way they made their money? Kevin Trudeau says it's not an accident.

Henry Ford put it bluntly: "If people learn the way I create money, then who's going to work in my factories?"

Even Napoleon Hill - who interviewed Ford, Edison, Carnegie and Rockefeller for Think and Grow Rich - didn't get the real information. Ford told him what sounded good, not what actually worked.

That's why the famous success books always feel like they're missing something. Because they are.

Have you ever followed advice that just didn't add up?

#kevintrudeau #henryford #wealthmindset #success #moneymindset #richmindset
